subject.title: fix(acp): keep completed run-mode sessions resumable

question: Should completed parent-owned ACP run-mode children that have a verified resume-capable backend identity remain follow-up-capable after normal runtime cleanup and gateway restart?
rationale: The patch is designed around an intentional lifecycle change rather than merely repairing an internal crash: selected terminal one-shots keep metadata and can reconnect to existing provider-side conversation state.

options.title: Accept resumable completed one-shots
options.body: Merge after refreshed CI if the product contract should let parents continue verified Codex and Claude run-mode conversations after completion.

options.title: Keep terminal one-shots non-resumable
options.body: Decline or narrow the change if completion must remain a hard boundary that always discards parent-owned run-mode session identity.

recommendation.title: Accept resumable completed one-shots
recommendation.body: Merge after refreshed CI if the product contract should let parents continue verified Codex and Claude run-mode conversations after completion.
